name: QM Service-Token Replay Rejection

citations.evidenceRole: process-local replayLedger Map and capacity/enabled state declaration
verifyServiceTokenRequest deriveReplayKey/ledger lookup and exact-replay rejection at exact match, fail-closed at capacity

claimBoundary: QM-derived control: verifyServiceTokenRequest rejects an exact-match replayed (token-identity-hash, timestamp, signature) tuple within one Node.js process's in-memory Map, bounded to the signature validity window. This control does not claim restart survival, multi-process or multi-instance coordination, distributed replay protection, or durable/persisted replay state; the ledger is a plain module-scope Map with no timer, daemon, or external IO.
